purpose: Source material for rule review and future supervised concept labels. Captions are not trade labels.

lessons.title: The GxT Model | 4H PO3 Made Mechanical
lessons.author: Garrett

rule_references.interpretation: A new 4H candle can continue a reversal already confirmed inside the previous 4H candle; the new open falls in lower-timeframe C3.
Trading reversal within the current 4H candle requires a lower-timeframe swing and a wick profile supporting expansion; otherwise wait.
A bullish C2 sweep that fails to close below C1's low confirms a reversal for C3; mirror for bearish.
A C3 close above C2's body or high is a separate swing-confirmation case; it is not the C2 continuation implementation.

lessons.title: The GxT Universal Sequence - Structured Approach
lessons.author: Garrett

rule_references.interpretation: Continuation uses refined gaps near higher-timeframe opening prices; the described 4H alignment uses 1H or 30m gaps.
Align a lower-timeframe key-level-to-objective model with a higher-timeframe model; equilibrium and selected gaps are part of the framework.
